title: Randall Museum

explain.meaning: Pay for a single class, with no membership or package.

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Note: Early registration for Randall Museum Members does not apply to Summer Camps. Randall Museum offers Day Camps serving kids ages 6 to 12 when school is out of session. Camps are separated into different age groups, offering a wide range of fun hands-on age-appropriate art and science activities. For the best chance of getting into the camp(s) of your choice, we highly recommend that you create your Family Account well in advance of camp registration, add desired camps to your wishlist and use the online registration system. For more information and questions not answered here, please contact Sarah Watanabe, Camp Manager:

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: As a part of the museum’s mission to inspire and connect students to STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art and Math), we expanded our science field trips to include in-class visits, where our instructors go to classrooms across San Francisco to present the Museum’s amazing science field trip classes. services.name: Toddler Tree House
services.desc: This room is a dedicated play space for our youngest visitors and their families. It has a beautiful wall mural, a custom made climbing structure, and is stocked with furniture, toys and books to facilitate free, creative play and provide a pleasant setting for young children and families.Learn

services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: The Randall Museum is a unique special event venue for small to mid-sized weddings, gatherings, celebrations, and meetings. Extensive grounds, spectacular city views, unique indoor exhibits, well equipped meeting rooms, and onsite parking. The entire facility is ADA compliant. Proceeds from special event space rentals support public programs and ensure broad community access to the Randall Museum. Hosting your child’s birthday celebration at the Randall is an unforgettable experience. Our museum instructors lead special engaging activities, our Buckley Room party space has beautiful views, and we have ample parking for your guests.
